For AI agents and LLMs: a structured documentation index is available at [/llms.txt](https://developer.paddle.com/llms.txt). Every page has a Markdown sibling — append `.md` to any URL. To search these docs, send a GET request to `https://paddle-docs-retrieval.kapa-paddle.workers.dev/?q=<question>` with a URL-encoded question. No authentication needed.

 [Skip to content](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/#main)

# Get started

Understand Paddle, find your use case, build a quickstart, and use AI tools to integrate faster.

[Get started](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/quickstart)

Will Paddle work for my use case?How do I open a checkout?What's the fastest way to integrate Paddle?

![Illustration showing a person carrying a large arrow pointing to the right while walking forward.](https://developer.paddle.com/_astro/new-get-started.CiPKeeYU.svg)

## Pick your path

[Learn how Paddle works\\
\\
Learn how Paddle works for SaaS, mobile, AI, and one-time products.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/how-paddle-works) [Quickstart\\
\\
Step through sandbox, catalog, pricing page, checkout, and webhooks end to end.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/quickstart) [Build with AI tools\\
\\
Wire the Paddle MCP server and docs MCP server to Lovable, Cursor, or Claude Code and prompt your integration.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/ai) [Deploy a starter kit\\
\\
Working Paddle apps you can clone, configure, and deploy — Next.js SaaS or mobile web payments.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/starter-kits) [Get the Node.js SDK\\
\\
Install the Paddle Node.js SDK, initialize a client, make your first request, and verify webhook signatures.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/quickstart/node) [Build with Lovable Payments\\
\\
Monetize you Lovable app using Lovable Payments, powered by Paddle.](https://developer.paddle.com/get-started/ai/lovable)
